descriptions.bk-brainstormer: Architecture brainstormer evaluating mobile approaches, debating trade-offs, and recommending optimal solutions.
descriptions.bk-code-reviewer: Read-only code reviewer checking architecture compliance, security, naming, and platform patterns.
descriptions.bk-code-simplifier: Post-implementation code simplifier refining recently changed mobile code for clarity and maintainability.
descriptions.bk-debugger: Diagnoses build failures, test failures, runtime crashes, and performance issues across mobile platforms.
descriptions.bk-device-test-agent: Writes UI test files and device test scenarios covering device matrix, UI automation, and edge cases.
descriptions.bk-docs-writer: Generates and updates project documentation — roadmap, changelog, architecture diagrams, code standards.
descriptions.bk-git-manager: Manages git operations — branching, conventional commits, PR creation via gh CLI.
descriptions.bk-performance-analyzer: Read-only performance analyst detecting main thread blocking, memory leaks, excessive rendering, and battery drain.
descriptions.bk-planner: Creates phased implementation plans from requirements — scouts codebase, researches patterns, outputs structured plan.
descriptions.bk-project-manager: Cross-feature coordinator tracking project status, managing task dependencies, and updating roadmap.
descriptions.bk-researcher: Researches external best practices, API docs, and technology recommendations via web search and documentation.
descriptions.bk-security-auditor: Read-only security auditor performing OWASP mobile top 10 analysis — secrets, tokens, network, storage.
descriptions.bk-test-architect: Designs test strategy, builds requirement-to-test traceability matrix, and produces test plan.
descriptions.bk-unit-test-agent: Writes and runs unit tests for business logic, repositories, and use cases. Targets 80%+ coverage.
descriptions.bk-code-reviewer.android: Android-specific review: Coroutines, viewModelScope, Compose state, Hilt injection, Gradle config.
descriptions.bk-code-reviewer.flutter: Flutter-specific review: state management consistency (BLoC/Riverpod), const usage, widget composition.
descriptions.bk-code-reviewer.ios: iOS-specific review: async/await, @MainActor, SwiftUI patterns, SPM dependencies, Info.plist.
descriptions.bk-debugger.android: Android debug: Gradle build errors, crash logs (Logcat), ANR traces, ProGuard issues.
descriptions.bk-debugger.flutter: Flutter debug: build errors, widget errors, state management issues, platform channel problems.
descriptions.bk-debugger.ios: iOS debug: xcodebuild errors, crash logs, memory graph, Instruments analysis.
descriptions.bk-unit-test-agent.android: Android testing: JUnit5 @Test, @DisplayName, MockK for mocking, Turbine for Flow testing.
descriptions.bk-unit-test-agent.flutter: Flutter testing: testWidgets(), group(), mocktail mocks, pump/pumpAndSettle.
descriptions.bk-unit-test-agent.ios: iOS testing: XCTestCase, async test methods, mock protocols, XCTAssert variants.
descriptions.bk-agent-contract: Required before dispatching agents. Defines agent I/O file contracts and implementation-result validation.
descriptions.bk-analyze: Pure exploration skill — analyze project structure, architecture, and dependencies without modifying code.
descriptions.bk-architecture: SOLID principles, Clean Architecture layers, MVVM pattern, Repository pattern, and dependency injection.
descriptions.bk-ask: Answer technical and architectural questions about mobile development with expert consultation.
descriptions.bk-autopilot: Auto-chain bk-plan → approval gate → bk-code in a single command.
descriptions.bk-bootstrap: Scan project codebase, detect platform/architecture/patterns, output foundation analysis report.
descriptions.bk-code: Implement mobile features from bk-plan output — dispatch agents, track progress, validate results.
descriptions.bk-code-quality: Quality standards for agentic coding: operational quality, code craftsmanship, and test coverage.
descriptions.bk-code-review-workflow: Quality standards for agentic code review: inspection depth, severity calibration, and review format.
descriptions.bk-code-workflow: Development workflow patterns for mobile agents — Design-First Gate, output verification, retry loops.
descriptions.bk-commit: Hook-guarded commit workflow — security check, diff summary, user approval gate, conventional commits.
descriptions.bk-context: Context management and token optimization for mobile development sessions.
descriptions.bk-debug: Bug fix workflow — classify, analyze root cause, code fix, test, review, commit.
descriptions.bk-design: Analyze Figma and synthesize pixel-perfect design specification into design.md for code generation.
descriptions.bk-docs: Documentation workflow — init, update, or summarize project documentation via bk-docs-writer agent.
descriptions.bk-docs-seeker: Look up latest SDK docs for mobile frameworks via context7.com. Use before coding with unfamiliar APIs.
descriptions.bk-generate: Generate mobile screen code from design specs using prompt-builder + compile-validate loop.
descriptions.bk-openapi-parse: Parse OpenAPI/Swagger specs into API models and endpoints for mobile consumption.
descriptions.bk-plan: Plan mobile features with structured input processing, code impact analysis, and phased output.
descriptions.bk-problem-solving: Apply systematic problem-solving techniques when stuck — complexity spirals, innovation blocks, scale uncertainty.
descriptions.bk-project-intake: Extract structured requirements from project documentation into actionable specs.
descriptions.bk-refactor: FSM-driven refactor workflow — analyze scope, refactor via dev agent, test existing suite, review.
descriptions.bk-repomix: Pack mobile project into LLM-optimized file with platform-aware presets for external analysis.
descriptions.bk-research: Research any topic with focused subagents. Quick mode for fast answers, deep mode for thorough analysis.
descriptions.bk-review: Hook-guarded review workflow — dispatch bk-code-reviewer, optional bk-security-auditor, collect reports.
descriptions.bk-scout: Fast codebase scouting using parallel agents for file discovery and task context gathering.
descriptions.bk-sequential-thinking: Step-by-step analysis for complex problems with revision capability and hypothesis verification.
descriptions.bk-spec: Collect, validate, and standardize all inputs for a feature before planning. Orchestrates intake pipeline.
descriptions.bk-srs: Generate Software Requirements Specification from bootstrap data and external inputs.
descriptions.bk-task-tracking: Required before dispatching agents. Provides plan JSON parsing, task status lifecycle, progress tracking.
descriptions.bk-team: Orchestrate Agent Teams for parallel multi-session mobile development, debugging, and review.
descriptions.bk-test: Test workflow — dispatch bk-test-architect for strategy, bk-unit-test-agent to write/run tests.
descriptions.bk-visual-verify: AI vision comparison of Figma design vs app screenshot for pixel-perfect verification.
descriptions.bk-worktree: Create isolated git worktree for parallel development in monorepos and mobile projects.
descriptions.approval-rules: Risk-based approval gates for commands — none/low/medium/high risk levels with corresponding gates.
descriptions.coding-intelligence-priority: Tool selection priority for code understanding tasks — higher priority = more accurate results.
descriptions.conductor-role: Single source of truth for conductor responsibilities, orchestration rules, and delegation patterns.
descriptions.core-rules: Essential orchestration rules. Agent-specific rules live in agent definitions.
descriptions.development-rules: Offline-first, battery-aware, platform-native development standards for mobile apps.
descriptions.documentation-management: Save plans in bk/dev directory with timestamp naming, structured phase files.
descriptions.metrics-collection: Track agent performance across workflows for data-driven optimization.
descriptions.mobile-shared-rules: Clean Architecture, MVVM pattern, dependency injection, error handling standards.
descriptions.reactive-orchestration: Conductor reads this rule after every agent return for intelligent next-step decisions.
descriptions.state-machine: Enforces valid phase transitions for FSM commands, prevents phase-skipping.
descriptions.task-scheduling: All agent dispatches must include timeout expectation for resource management.
descriptions.user-interaction-protocol: Unified rules for when and how to interact with user via AskUserQuestion.
descriptions.Bootstrap New Project: Run bk-{platform} init → scaffolds .claude/ with agents, skills, hooks. Then use /bk-bootstrap to set up project structure, dependencies, and CI/CD.
descriptions.Generate API Layer from Swagger: Import OpenAPI/Swagger spec → /bk-generate parses endpoints → generates models, API client, and repository layer with proper error handling.
descriptions.Debug a Crash: Use /bk-debug with crash logs or stack trace → bk-debugger agent analyzes root cause → suggests fix with code patch → /bk-test validates the fix.
descriptions.Code Review Workflow: After implementation, /bk-review triggers bk-code-reviewer → checks code quality, patterns, security → generates review report with actionable items.
descriptions.Design to Code (Figma): Connect figma-mcp-go → /bk-spec --design extracts components, colors, typography (design-validator + design-spec-writer + design-asset-exporter) → /bk-code generates platform-native UI code (SwiftUI/Compose/Flutter widgets).
descriptions.iOS — SwiftUI View from Design: Figma screen → /bk-spec --design → /bk-code → SwiftUI View with @State, @Binding, proper previews. Follows MVVM + Coordinator pattern per bk-ios rules.
descriptions.Android — Compose Screen from API: OpenAPI endpoint → /bk-generate → Kotlin data classes, Retrofit service, ViewModel with StateFlow, Compose UI. Follows Clean Architecture layers.
descriptions.Flutter — Widget + BLoC from Spec: Feature spec → /bk-code → Dart models, BLoC/Cubit with states, Widget tree with BlocBuilder. Includes unit + widget tests.
